entities.summary: William Beattie Ramsay was a Canadian ice hockey player. He won an Olympic gold medal as a member of the Toronto Granites ice hockey team that represented Canada in ice hockey at the 1924 Winter Olympics. He later played 43 games in the National Hockey League with the Toronto Maple Leafs during the 1927–28 season.
